title: Large Sieve and Quadratic Sets
exact_target: If a set of positive integers occupies at most half the residue classes modulo every sufficiently large prime, must it either be substantially smaller than square-root size or lie entirely among the values of one rational quadratic polynomial at integers?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 109 (GREEN-021). CC BY 4.0.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, author manuscript with December 2025 updates, Problem 47 and its comments, p. 23.
